# lmw saved

Show the posts you saved

### Synopsis

Show the posts you saved on LinkedIn, most recently saved first. For saved jobs, use `lmw jobs tracked`.

```
lmw saved [flags]
```

### Examples

```
  lmw saved -n 20
  lmw saved --json
```

### Options

```
  -h, --help        help for saved
  -n, --limit int   number of posts (1-50) (default 10)
```

### Options inherited from parent commands

```
      --json      print JSON output
  -v, --verbose   show debug logs, including every API request
```
